stories.title: The "cuck commentary desk": a hotel room whose desk faces the bed
stories.summary: A photo of a cramped hotel room, with a long desk and two chairs lined up facing the bed, went up late Sunday captioned "Behold, the cuck commentary desk". By Monday it was everywhere: the top quote post, a clip of sports commentators losing their minds at the call, got 550K likes, and people kept adding their own play-by-play.
